subject: Confidential pilot subsidy request — on‑prem evaluation
messages:
From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@cerebrumhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cerebrumhealth.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Confidential pilot subsidy request — on-prem evaluation

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are planning a timeboxed, on-prem pilot of Redwood's private runtime for a sensitive clinical routing feature. Because this will run in our air-gapped clinic network and involve PHI, we need a short subsidized evaluation to validate integration, throughput, and auditability before we can commit to an enterprise contract.

High-level ask:
- 6-week pilot with a single isolated cluster (on-prem appliance) + 24/7 support for first week
- Access to an ML endpoint equivalent to r-infer-large with KV caching enabled
- Subsidized credits to cover inference (we estimate ~120k tokens/day peak) + 1 week of dedicated onboarding engineer time

Security/compliance constraints:
- We require SOC 2 attestation or comparable security questionnaire answers before we enable the pilot
- Customer-managed KMS (we need HSM/KMS integration documentation)
- Audit logs retention for 90 days and evidence of RBAC and network isolation

Attached: Cerebrum_NDA_signed.pdf (we returned the NDA you sent). Procurement contact is on cc — they will pick up contract/PO questions once scope and subsidy are agreed.

Can Redwood support a trial subsidy and what evidence do you need from our side to move forward?

Appreciate it,
Lydia
Director, Product Security
Cerebrum Health

Hi Lydia — thanks for the clear ask and for returning the NDA. Apologies for the abbreviated reply; I wanted to confirm we received this and will start pulling together the next steps.

A few quick items we need from your side to scope the subsidy properly:
- Ballpark total token budget for the 6-week window (your 120k/day peak is helpful; can you give an expected median?)
- Which infra model you want (we can map r-infer-large -> private-dedicated-v1 equivalent)
- Any special data residency or air-gap instructions beyond "on-prem" (e.g., offline sync windows)

I’m looping in Marissa (sales lead) to draft a Mutual Action Plan and Karthik (security engineering) for the technical evidence checklist. We’ll aim to propose a credit + engineering support package by EOD Thursday.

— Sofia

Team / Lydia,

Putting together a pragmatic package that balances risk and runway. Draft proposal below — happy to iterate: 

Proposal (draft)
- Credit allocation: 180,000 token-equivalent credits for the 6-week pilot (covers peak + safety buffer)
- Environ: single private on-prem cluster; we’ll ship a preconfigured runtime image and assist with KMS integration
- Onboarding: 3 days remote + 1 full day onsite (if allowed) of a Redwood engineer; 24/7 pager for first 48 hours
- Security gating: access granted once we receive SOC 2 attestation OR completed vendor security questionnaire (we can accept completed questionnaire + sampled evidence)
- Contract: short MOU via DocuSign to formalize subsidy and termination terms

Attachments: MAP_Cerebrum_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan / milestones + acceptance criteria).

Budget rationale: credits sized to cover inference costs and to avoid interruptions due to spend caps; the engineering days are to ensure we meet your audit/logging requirements quickly. If they prefer a longer onsite complement instead of credits, we can trade down tokens for more eng days.

Marissa
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confidential pilot subsidy request — security checklist & minimum evidence

Lydia / team,

Thanks — a couple of clarifying security items from Redwood’s side so we can scope the sandbox properly:

Minimum evidence we need before enabling an on-prem private runtime:
- SOC 2 Type II report OR completed security questionnaire + signed attestation for controls in scope
- Confirmation of customer-managed KMS workflow (we support AWS KMS, HashiCorp Vault, and HSM via PKCS#11)
- Network topology diagram showing the air-gapped boundaries and the provisioning channel
- Required log retention: we will produce audit logs; please confirm if 90 days is sufficient or if you need 180
- Encryption in transit and at rest details — we will encrypt both by default; provide any additional cipher requirements now

Operational notes:
- For an on-prem image we will provide an offline install package and a checksum manifest
- We require a single point of contact for JML (join/leave) so we can manage RBAC during the pilot

If you can drop the SOC 2 PDF or questionnaire answers into the Drive link below, we’ll validate and spin up the pilot image for your infra team to install.

— Karthik
Security Engineering — Redwood Inference

If the above is acceptable, Marissa: please send the MOU link to the customer and confirm the HubSpot deal (I will attach the internal approval note to the CRB-2027-0421 record).
